canonical_project: Greater Bay Area Runze (Huizhou) International Information Port
owner: Runze Technology Development Co., Ltd.; Tianren Investment Co., Ltd.; China Telecom Guangdong as operating partner
notes: Runze says the Huizhou information port started construction in Baihua town, covers 192 mu, plans 200,000 sq m of high-standard data-center rooms, and was planned for completion/operation by end-2023; no MW disclosed.
